{{short description|Italian mathematician}}
'''Giulio Pittarelli''' (3 February 1852, [[Campochiaro]], [[Campobasso]] – 2 March 1934, Rome<ref name=Maccozzo>{{cite journal|title=Giulio Pittarelli Commemorazione tenuta da Renzo Maccozzo|year=2005|journal=Rendiconti di Matematico|series=Serie VII|pages=241–245|url=http://www.euclide-scuola.org/files/N.%2018%20a%20N.%2022%20-%20Euclide%20anno%202014/N.%2018%20(14%20febbraio%202014)/7.6%20Renzo%20Mazzocco,%20Biografia%20di%20Giulio%20Pittarelli.pdf}} (with bibliography of Pittarelli's publications)</ref>) was an Italian mathematician, specializing in [[descriptive geometry]] and algebraic geometry.<ref name=Bio>{{cite web|title=Giulio Pittarelli (1852 – 1934)|website=Edizione Nazionale Mathematica Italiana, mathematica.sns.it|url=http://mathematica.sns.it/autori/1173/}}</ref>

Pittarelli received from the [[University of Naples]] his ''laurea'' in mathematics in 1874 and in engineering in 1876. For many years he was a professor of descriptive geometry at the [[Sapienza University of Rome]]. In addition to his mathematical career, he was a painter, an excellent pianist, and an author, who wrote a biography of [[Luigi Cremona]].<ref name=Bio/><ref name=Maccozzo/>

Pittarelli was an invited speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1908 in Rome.<ref>{{cite book|author=Pittarelli, Giulio|chapter= Luca Pacioli usurpò per se stesso qualche libro di Piero de' Francheschi ?|pages=436–440|volume=3|title=Atti del IV Congresso internazionale dei matematici (Roma, 6–11 April 1908)|series= ICM proceedings|date= 1897|publisher= University of Toronto Press|chapter-url=https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=iau.31858027749682;view=1up;seq=458}}</ref>

*[https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=mdp.39015069416090;view=1up;seq=258 "Intorno ad un problema die eliminazione nella teoria analitica della cubica gobba."] Giornale di Matematiche di Battaglini 17 (1879): 244–259.
*[https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=mdp.39015069416090;view=1up;seq=274 "La cubica gobba e le forme binarie quadratiche e cubiche."] Giornale di Matematiche di Battaglini 17 (1879): 260–309.
* [https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=hvd.32044102914181;view=1up;seq=167 "La lumache di Pascal (Nota I)."] Giornale di Matematiche di Battaglini 21 (1883): 145–168.
* [https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=hvd.32044102914181;view=1up;seq=195 "La lumache di Pascal (Nota II)."] Giornale di Matematiche di Battaglini 21 (1883): 173–212.
*"I gruppi continui proiettivi semplicemente infiniti nello spazio ordinario." Annali di Matematica Pura ed Applicata (1867–1897) 22, no. 1 (1894): 261-311. {{doi|10.1007/BF02353939}}
